title: Affordance library and traversal-graph export
summary: Map surface classes to traversal verbs (the affordance library) and export the traversal graph: which surfaces reach which, by which verb, at what difficulty.

acceptance_tests.test: The affordance library maps each Bible §4 class to its enabled verbs (Bible §4 matrix); the traversal graph exports nodes and verb-tagged edges into traversal_graph.json.
Schema-validates; a test confirms every edge's verb is enabled for the source surface class.
The affordance mapping lives in one place, consumed by both the graph export and the validator.
